topic: Campaign impression calculation issues and fixes
summary_markdown:
The group discussed two issues regarding campaign data. First, campaigns for countries west of Greenwich have less than 24 hours of data for 'last day' reporting, which the data team currently ignores.
Second, impression counts are calculated approximately due to various hacks. A task was created (DOOH-1801) to improve this calculation toward a more direct and accurate method. The next step involves using these new columns as viewable/viewed impressions in campaigns. Regarding the implementation of the new calculations, it was decided that the 'impressions' field added by someone (Vlad) into agg_ml should be removed because it is confusing.
decisions: The data team will continue to ignore reporting issues for countries west of Greenwich with less than 24 hours of data.
The 'impressions' field in agg_ml, added by someone (Vlad), will be removed when the current impression calculations are replaced with viewable/viewed metrics.
action_items: Use the new columns from task DOOH-1801 as viewable/viewed impressions in campaigns.
